title: Show the running role for relays started outside ork
lead: Seen 2026-10-20: ork status shows 'S23 active (3 steps, 2 running)' for a ledger run, with no role or phase. The ledger has steps with role, vendor, model and phase (slicer relay-run list). Show the running role and the last failed step in the Overview and ork status.
